evidence.evidence_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) methods have demonstrated significant potential on tasks across multiple domains.
Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) methods have demonstrated significant potential on tasks across multiple domains.

The previous works ignore the negative impact of this fuzzy data on RAG system.We explore the capabilities of LLMs and RAG systems in dialogue scenarios and use Incomplete Utterance Rewriting (IUR) to complete the key information in dialogue to enhance retrieval.Besides, we propose a lightweight IUR model for query rewriting.

This framework treats IUR as a series of link decisions on the input sequence and the incrementally constructed rewriting outputs.To test the performance of RAG system in the model multi-round dialogue scenario, we construct an RAG dialogue dataset on English and Chinese, Dialogue-RAG-MULTI-v1.0.Experiment results show that utterance rewriting can effectively improve the retrieval and generation ability of RAG system in dialogue scenes.
